missing_information_behavior: Do not make a generic probiotic recommendation; clarify the symptom/diagnosis and require evidence for the exact strain and formulation.
safety_exclusions: Do not generalize evidence from one strain to all probiotics.
Do not promise treatment of unspecified digestive symptoms.
Do not assume CFU count alone establishes efficacy.
professional_escalation_conditions: Immunocompromised status, severe illness, central venous catheter, recent major surgery, fever, blood in stool, severe pain or persistent symptoms.
population_and_context: People selecting digestive health as a goal; probiotic evidence is strain-, product-, condition- and outcome-specific.
dose_constraints: No generic dose from this rule. Any product-specific regimen must match studied strain(s), viable count, indication and label conditions.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Probiotics fact sheet emphasizes strain- and condition-specific evidence; safety may differ in medically vulnerable users. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
